additions.name: integration_ledger_revocations
additions.sql: CREATE TABLE integration_ledger_revocations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,org_id TEXT NOT NULL,binding_id TEXT NOT NULL,worker_id TEXT NOT NULL,realm TEXT NOT NULL,client_id TEXT NOT NULL,credential_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,disabled_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,authority TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('sending','unknown','confirmed','released')),claim TEXT,started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,finished_at INTEGER,evidence TEXT,review_revision INTEGER,UNIQUE(org_id,binding_id,credential_revision)) STRICT
